mapper.sql: id, coupon_id, user_id, order_id, coupon_status, get_type, get_time, using_time, used_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: select from coupon_user where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into coupon_user ( coupon_id, user_id, order_id, coupon_status, get_type, get_time, using_time, used_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) values ( #{couponId}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{couponStatus}, #{getType}, #{getTime}, #{usingTime}, #{usedTime}, #{expireTime}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update coupon_user set order_id = #{orderId}, coupon_status = 2, using_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and coupon_status = 1 and is_deleted = 0
